scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Business blog, shopping-success guide, shopping-performance checklist and Predicts material were checked on 19 October 2026. Together they expose a durable catalogue-scale creative workflow: verified feed data, meaningful product grouping, product-first plus lifestyle and creator/UGC diversity, shoppable boards or collages, mobile and post-click consistency, reliable tracking and controlled testing. A public Pinterest graphic-design trends board returned HTTP 403, so no visual inference was made from inaccessible content.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.23.0 with 718 commands was read before evaluation. /visual-search-ready, /performance-creative-mix and /intent-to-action cover individual assets, testing and the customer journey, but no command joined feed truth, SKU grouping, scalable creative variants, product tagging, post-click parity and measurement into one reusable system. /catalog-creative-system was therefore added as one focused command. All 718 prior commands, 42 categories, 40 executable bundle mappings, settings, personal creative intelligence and Firefox updater controls were preserved; 18 regression checks passed.
trends: Product-feed accuracy and diagnostics are creative foundations because titles, descriptions, images, prices, availability and product IDs determine discovery and delivery
Catalogue-scale systems benefit from meaningful assortments with sufficient SKU depth rather than many tiny arbitrary groups
Shopping creative should deliberately span product-first, lifestyle, creator/UGC, demonstration, curated-board and collage roles while preserving exact product truth
Shoppable creative requires consistent price, image, promotion and product identity from ad through product page, cart and checkout
Always-on catalogue learning, seasonal creative rotation and controlled A/B hypotheses are more useful than repeatedly rebuilding campaigns
Public design-trend snippets repeated human imperfection, retro-futurism, maximalism, distortion and tactility already covered by the existing visual catalogue
commands_added: /catalog-creative-system — converts a verified product feed into catalogue-scale product-first, lifestyle, UGC, demonstration, board and collage creative with SKU truth, grouping, preflight checks, post-click parity and a controlled test plan
skipped: No separate product-feed-audit command because feed truth and diagnostics are embedded as the first stage of /catalog-creative-system
No separate shopping-collage, creator-catalog or product-group command because those are coordinated asset and assortment roles inside the new system
No always-on-shopping or conversion-tracking alias because campaign-duration and tracking checks are safeguards in the new command rather than visual creative commands on their own

No naive-design, future-medieval, distorted-portrait, maximalism, blur or retro-futurism aliases because existing human, retro, editorial, distortion, tactile and trend-to-brand controls already cover the reusable production behavior
No command was derived from the inaccessible public Pinterest board
